from pathlib import Path

# Load the workbook
file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/53161/1_53161_input.xlsx'
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
sheet = wb['Sheet1']

# Define the data structures
# Agent Categories table: rows 4-9 (1-indexed), columns 5-14 (E-N)
agent_categories_start_row = 4
agent_categories_end_row = 9
agent_categories_start_col = 5  # Column E (Agent names)
categories_start_col = 6  # Column F (Category 1)
categories_end_col = 14  # Column N (Category 9)

# Agent Schedule table: rows 13-18, columns 5-31 (E-AE)
agent_schedule_start_row = 13
agent_schedule_end_row = 18
schedule_start_col = 5  # Column E (Agent names)
time_slots_start_col = 6  # Column F (first time slot)
time_slots_end_col = 31  # Column AE (last time slot)

# Results table: rows 22-29, columns 6-31 (F-AE)
results_start_row = 22
results_end_row = 29
results_start_col = 6  # Column F
results_end_col = 31  # Column AE

# Read agent names from Agent Categories table
agent_names = []
for row in range(agent_categories_start_row, agent_categories_end_row + 1):
    agent_name = sheet.cell(row=row, column=agent_categories_start_col).value
    if agent_name:
        agent_names.append(agent_name)

print(f"Found {len(agent_names)} agents: {agent_names}")

# Read agent categories (which categories each agent is assigned to)
# agent_categories[agent_name][category_index] = 1 or None
agent_categories = {}
for i, agent_name in enumerate(agent_names):
    row = agent_categories_start_row + i
    agent_categories[agent_name] = {}
    for cat_idx in range(9):  # 9 categories (Category 1 to Category 9)
        col = categories_start_col + cat_idx
        value = sheet.cell(row=row, column=col).value
        agent_categories[agent_name][cat_idx] = value

print(f"\nAgent categories loaded for {len(agent_categories)} agents")

# Read agent schedules (which time slots each agent is scheduled)
# agent_schedules[agent_name][time_slot_index] = 1 or None
agent_schedules = {}
for i, agent_name in enumerate(agent_names):
    row = agent_schedule_start_row + i
    agent_schedules[agent_name] = {}
    for time_idx in range(time_slots_end_col - time_slots_start_col + 1):
        col = time_slots_start_col + time_idx
        value = sheet.cell(row=row, column=col).value
        agent_schedules[agent_name][time_idx] = value

print(f"Agent schedules loaded for {len(agent_schedules)} agents")

# Calculate results: for each category and time slot, count agents who:
# 1. Are scheduled at that time slot (have 1 in schedule)
# 2. Are assigned to that category (have 1 in categories)

num_categories = 8  # We're filling rows 22-29, which is Category 1 to Category 8
num_time_slots = results_end_col - results_start_col + 1

print(f"\nCalculating results for {num_categories} categories and {num_time_slots} time slots...")

for cat_idx in range(num_categories):  # Category 1 to Category 8 (0-7)
    result_row = results_start_row + cat_idx
    for time_idx in range(num_time_slots):
        result_col = results_start_col + time_idx
        
        # Count agents who are both scheduled and assigned to this category
        count = 0
        for agent_name in agent_names:
            # Check if agent is scheduled at this time
            is_scheduled = agent_schedules[agent_name].get(time_idx) == 1
            # Check if agent is assigned to this category
            has_category = agent_categories[agent_name].get(cat_idx) == 1
            
            if is_scheduled and has_category:
                count += 1
        
        # Write the count to the result cell
        sheet.cell(row=result_row, column=result_col, value=count)

print("Results calculated and written to cells F22:AE29")

# Save the workbook
output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/53161_0_031f6a95/1_53161_output.xlsx'
Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

        result_col = results_start_col + time_idx
